description: This file defines the 'FieldElement' interface in the org.apache.commons.math3 package. It specifies the operations for elements within a mathematical field, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, negation, and obtaining the multiplicative inverse. It also provides method documentation and references to exceptions and related classes.

classes.name: FieldElement
classes.description: Interface representing an element of a mathematical field, with methods for arithmetic operations and field properties.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Computes the sum of this element with another element of the same field.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Computes the difference between this element and another element.

methods.name: negate
methods.description: Returns the additive inverse of this element.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies this element by an integer n, i.e., n times this element.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Computes the product of this element and another element of the same field.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Divides this element by another element, throwing an exception if division by zero occurs.

methods.name: reciprocal
methods.description: Returns the multiplicative inverse of this element.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the Field to which this element belongs.
